Lottie for iOS

Source: https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-ios (4.6.1)
Copyright 2018 Airbnb, Inc. and contributors
License: Apache License, Version 2.0

NotchHub V1 links Lottie statically in the Direct edition to render the
Bodymovin media artwork. A complete copy of the Apache-2.0 license is bundled
beside this notice as Lottie-LICENSE.txt. Lottie's pinned privacy manifest is
bundled at Contents/Resources/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy because its code is part of
the Direct app executable.
